description: Header file defining the LocalTracer class and related classes for messaging and tracing in the Thunder project.

classes.name: LocalTracer
classes.description: Main class managing messaging, tracing, and logging functionalities with singleton access.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to handle messages.

classes.name: LocalTracer::MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message unit settings.

classes.name: LocalTracer::WorkerThread
classes.description: Worker thread class for dispatching messages.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ConsolePrinter
classes.description: Implementation of ICallback that prints messages to console.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Open
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LocalTracer.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Close
methods.description: Closes and deletes the singleton instance, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: LocalTracer::EnableMessage
methods.description: Enables or disables message tracing for a specific module and category.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and calls the callback.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for message notifications.
